info.title: Thaniumnine Data API
info.description:
API reference for device metadata, historical measurements, aggregation records, fault detection and diagnostics (FDD), tasks and scheduling.

## Getting started
All paths in this reference are relative to `/api/v1`. The configured server is a local development instance. Replace example identifiers with values from an environment you are authorised to use.

## Authentication
Use `POST /auth/login` to obtain an access token. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` on protected operations. Use `POST /auth/refresh` to refresh the session and `POST /auth/logout` to revoke it. Authentication requirements are based on the Postman collection's bearer configuration; verify them against the API.

## About this draft
Request examples are sanitised from the Postman collection; schema types are inferred from examples and are not a complete validation contract. All example identifiers and timestamps are illustrative. The collection does not contain matching saved responses, so response codes and payloads are not asserted as verified. The login example is inferred from the available authentication fields. Live requests are disabled by default. Do not use production credentials or customer data in examples.
